quick_skim.title: An Immersed Interface Method for Parabolic Interface Problems with Nonlinear Jump Conditions
quick_skim.abstract: We develop an immersed interface finite difference method for a one-dimensional nonlinear parabolic interface problem with jump condition \[ [u]_α=λu^+u^-. \] The method combines a Crank--Nicolson immersed interface discretization with an \(s\)-parameter reduction of the nonlinear interface condition, thereby reducing the nonlinear coupling to a scalar quadratic equation. We also discuss two different viewpoints for combining Newton iteration with immersed interface discretization, namely the IIM--Newton and Newton--IIM formulations. Numerical experiments are presented to illustrate the behavior and accuracy of the method.
quick_skim.llm_evidence_en: Immersed interface method for parabolic interface problems with nonlinear jump conditions, providing a numerical technique for two-phase flow interface simulation.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Develops an immersed interface finite difference method for one-dimensional nonlinear parabolic interface problems with jump conditions. The method combines Crank-Nicolson discretization with a parameter reduction of the nonlinear condition, enabling efficient solution. Numerical experiments demonstrate the method's accuracy, offering a transferable approach for interface problems in multiphase flow simulations.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对一维非线性抛物型界面问题，提出一种浸没界面有限差分方法。该方法结合Crank-Nicolson离散与非线性界面条件的参数缩减，将非线性耦合转化为标量二次方程，简化了求解过程。文中还讨论了IIM-Newton与Newton-IIM两种结合方式，展示了方法的灵活性。数值实验验证了方法的准确性，为多相流界面问题的数值模拟提供了可借鉴的技术途径。
